message.content: {"scores":{"c1":9,"c2":7,"c3":9},"evidence":"Word count is about 72 words, close to the 78-word target. c1: the claims match the source: three stages, 1948–1955 clichés, 1955–1958 silence, 1958 complex analysis, and differences in theory and international assessments. \"Анализ тематических статей, рецензий и разделов\" is a mild elaboration but is grounded in the source's discussion of sections and reviews. \"Выявивший глубокое различие\" corresponds to the source's \"существенной и глубокой\". c2: the subject, method and the three stages are covered. Of the three groups of claims, the second, the assessment of the USSR's experience of building socialism, is omitted. The groups are also not framed as three categories. c3: the text is coherent Russian, contains only the abstract and keeps to length. The hedging is mostly preserved, though the source's qualifier \"всегда было отрицательным, но не одинаковым\" is not carried over."}
